about: Moshpit companion, pixel theme. Source of truth for every pixel sprite: a palette per appearance, parts as rows of palette keys ('.' is transparent), and frames as layers of parts at [x, y] (an optional 'flip' mirrors a part). tools/build.py renders it. Grid 24 x 24; draw at whole device pixels per cell (24 pt at 1 pt per cell, 40 pt = 5 px per cell at 3x).

genome.about: Fur palettes recolour a species' b/s/h keys. Index 0 is the species' own colours. Shiny replaces them with a two-band body.
